question: Which of the following novels is written by Chetan Bhagat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The 3 Mistakes of My Life.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 3 Mistakes of My Life:-**

 
 
• **It is a 2008 novel by Indian author Chetan Bhagat. (Hence option 3 is correct)**
 
• It is a coming-of-age story about three friends, Govind, Ishaan, and Omi, who grow up together in the city of Ahmedabad, India.
 
• The novel follows their journey as they navigate through the challenges of adolescence, friendship, and love, while also dealing with the social and political turmoil of their time.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** The White Tiger:-**

 
 
• **It is a 2008 novel by Indian author Aravind Adiga. It was published in 2008 and won the 40th Booker Prize the same year. **
 
• The novel provides a darkly humorous perspective of India's class struggle in a globalized world as told through a retrospective narration from Balram Halwai, a village boy.
 
• The novel examines issues of the Hindu religion, caste, loyalty, corruption and poverty in India.
 
 
 
• **Our Story Needs No Filter:-**
 
 
• **It was written by Indian author Sudeep Nagarkar. It was published in 2017 and is his eighth novel. **
 
• The novel is a coming-of-age story about two college students, Arjun and Zara, who fall in love.
 
• However, their relationship is tested by the challenges of campus politics, social media, and their own personal insecurities.
 
 
 
• **Untouchable:-**
 
 
• **It was written by Indian author Mulk Raj Anand. **
 
• It was published in 1935 and is considered to be one of the most important novels of Indian literature.
 
• The novel tells the story of Bakha, a young sweeper who is discriminated against because of his low caste.
